title: Moving Home with a Beacon Ridge Solar Share Subscription
content:
## Rule

When the subscriber moves to another premise served by the same electric utility and the plan provides that the subscription moves with the subscriber within the same utility, the Community Solar Subscriptions subscription moves to the new premise without a fee and keeps its term and size, reduced if needed to meet the sizing limit of the new premise.

A transfer is made only on an active subscription; whether the subscription is active is judged from its status in the system record.

A move to a different utility cannot be transferred; the subscriber cancels, and the cancellation fee rules decide the fee.

## What a transfer records

The subscription carries the new premise, and the transfer date is the date the utility moved the allocation. The term dates of the subscription are unchanged by the transfer.

## Judgement table

| Subscription status | New premise's electric utility | Transfer |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Same utility as the current premise | Moves without a fee; term kept; size kept, reduced if needed to meet the new premise's sizing limit |
| Active | A different utility | Cannot be transferred; the subscriber cancels and the cancellation fee rules decide the fee |
| Waitlisted | Same utility | No transfer: the subscription is not active |
| Cancellation pending | Same utility | No transfer: the subscription is not active |

## Basis questions

- *Is there a fee for moving the subscription?* No; a transfer within the same utility is made without a fee.
- *Does the term restart at the new premise?* No; the subscription keeps its term.
- *Does the size change on a transfer?* The subscription keeps its size, reduced if needed to meet the sizing limit of the new premise.
